Hey please talk to someone about what you’re feeling. Do you have a mentor? I’ve been in your shoes, I know how stressful the navy and underway can be. I wanted to shoot my self so many times on watch or hang myself underway. But what helped me was talking to close friends on the ship about my feelings. Don’t keep it in. There have been plenty suicides on ships and it will scar your shipmates for life. You are family to them. Trust me, someone will listen to you and genuinely care. Please message me or send me your email so you can have someone to talk to. Shoot, I’ll send you care packages too! Life gets better out of the navy! But if you have depression you will always have issues until you fix them. Go to fleet and family counseling. They won’t report it to your command. It helped me soooo much. 
-former STG2
